packageRules.description: Security fixes only: every other update is off, npm packages, GitHub Actions and Docker images alike (vulnerabilityAlerts overrides this rule)
Next 16 is a migration that comes with the v3: no next or eslint-config-next above 15, security alerts included (allowedVersions filters the versions those alerts can pick)
Tailwind CSS 4 needs a migration (postcss plugin, config, CSS entry): stay on v3, security alerts included
